verdicts.reason: The cited APP transcription, dated October 13, 1900, expressly identifies the Executive Order of March 30, 1886 and reproduces the quoted territorial attachment. This confirms a lead, not an accepted original.

APP confirms the transfer language and Section 3141 as the 1900 authority; continued attachment in 1900 is a reasonable inference. It does not establish the 1886 order's authority. That component remains unverified.
The cited Wikisource index's 1910 section lists 1265½, November 25, with the quoted title. It establishes only a candidate ending, not express supersession.
The cited Monthly Catalog URL was inaccessible, and a targeted search did not recover the quoted record. Neither the quotation nor identification with the 1910 order was confirmed.
